tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: Return the profile represented by the authenticated iBlueprint credentials for this request.

id.description: Stable opaque identifier for the authenticated iBlueprint profile.

name.description: Display name for the authenticated profile.

nickname.description: A label that helps distinguish connected accounts.

tools.name: list_node_types
tools.title: List node types
tools.description: List every Blueprint node type the runtime supports with its category, runtime status, and summary.

tools.name: get_node_type
tools.title: Get node type contract
tools.description: Get the config shape and usage rules for one node type. Call this before adding a node or changing its config.

tools.name: import_curl
tools.title: Import cURL command
tools.description: Translate a cURL command into API-node config that sends the same request, using the same importer as the editor's "Import from cURL". Call this whenever the user pastes a cURL command or asks a node to match one; do not translate cURL by hand. Returns config to put in an api node (update_node set.config merges it), the blueprint secrets to create (credentials become $env:NAME references and are never returned), and notes.

command.description: The cURL command exactly as the user pasted it.

tools.name: get_blueprint
tools.title: Get blueprint outline
tools.description: Get the outline of a Blueprint: title, description, and every node id, type, title, parent loop, and outgoing connection. Use get_node for a node's config.

blueprintId.description: Blueprint UUID. Optional in the editor, where it defaults to the open canvas.

tools.name: get_node
tools.title: Get node
tools.description: Get one node's full configuration plus its incoming and outgoing connections.

blueprintId.description: Blueprint UUID. Optional in the editor, where it defaults to the open canvas.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List saved agents in the organization (own and shared) with whether each is ready to run. Use these ids for agent node config.agentId.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter on name and description.

organizationId.description: Organization UUID. Optional; defaults to the current organization.

tools.name: get_agent_readiness
tools.title: Check agent readiness
tools.description: Check whether a saved agent can run with a given tool and MCP selection, and list the tools its profile allows.

toolIds.description: Optional tool UUIDs the node would allow.

mcpServerIds.description: Optional MCP server UUIDs the node would use.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.title: List tools
tools.description: List verified tools available to the organization. Use these ids for agent_tool, composed_tool, and agent allowedTools.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter on name and description.

organizationId.description: Organization UUID. Optional; defaults to the current organization.

tools.name: list_mcp_servers
tools.title: List MCP servers
tools.description: List MCP servers the user can use. Use these ids for agent mcpServerIds and these URLs for mcp node serverUrl.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter on name and description.

tools.name: list_knowledge_bases
tools.title: List knowledge bases
tools.description: List knowledge bases available to the organization. Use these ids for kb inputs, outputs, and knowledge-base nodes.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter on name and description.

organizationId.description: Organization UUID. Optional; defaults to the current organization.

tools.name: list_environment_variables
tools.title: List environment variables
tools.description: List the blueprint's environment variables (names and whether each is a secret; values are never returned). Reference one in a node config as $env:NAME.

blueprintId.description: Blueprint UUID. Optional in the editor, where it defaults to the open canvas.

tools.name: validate_operations
tools.title: Validate blueprint edits
tools.description: Validate proposed edit operations against the operation schema and the current blueprint: unknown ids, broken branches, nested loops, and pauses inside loops.

operations.description: The operations you intend to return.

blueprintId.description: Blueprint UUID. Optional in the editor, where it defaults to the open canvas.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the user belongs to, with their role, and which one is current. Pass one of these ids as organizationId to the tools that need it, such as list_agents and list_tools.

tools.name: list_blueprints
tools.title: List blueprints
tools.description: List the Blueprints the user can see, newest first, with id, title, description, status, and links to its page (url) and editor (editorUrl). Use search to filter by name, description, or category.

tools.name: get_blueprint_inputs
tools.title: Get blueprint inputs
tools.description: Get the input variables a Blueprint expects (name, type, description, default) before calling run_blueprint, and whether the user may run it.

tools.name: run_blueprint
tools.title: Run blueprint
tools.description: Start a run of a saved Blueprint and return its executionId and a link to the run (url) at once; the run continues in the background. Follow it with get_execution. Runs use the user's AI connections and count toward their compute budget.

variables.description: Input values keyed by variable name. See get_blueprint_inputs.

connectionId.description: Optional AI connection id; defaults to the user's default connection.

modelId.description: Optional model override for prompt nodes.

tools.name: get_execution
tools.title: Get run status
tools.description: Get a run's status, progress, per-step results, recent logs, and why it is blocked if it is. Poll until status is completed, failed, or cancelled; a run waiting on a person reports awaitingInput. Includes a link to the run in iBlueprint (url).

executionId.description: Execution UUID, from run_blueprint or list_executions.

tools.name: list_executions
tools.title: List runs
tools.description: List recent runs, newest first. With blueprintId, lists that blueprint's runs the user can see; otherwise the user's own runs.

blueprintId.description: Optional Blueprint UUID to filter by.

tools.name: apply_blueprint_operations
tools.title: Save blueprint edits
tools.description: Save edit operations to a Blueprint. All operations are checked first and nothing is saved if any fails. The current content is saved as a named version before the change, so the user can restore it from version history. Run validate_operations first and show the user the change before saving.

operations.description: Edit operations, as accepted by validate_operations: add_node, update_node, delete_node, add_edge, delete_edge, set_agent_prompt, rename_blueprint.

summary.description: One line describing the change, stored on the backup version.

tools.name: create_blueprint
tools.title: Create blueprint
tools.description: Create a new private draft Blueprint, optionally with nodes built from edit operations (the same ones validate_operations accepts; there is no existing node to reference). Returns its id and a link to open it in the editor.

organizationId.description: Organization UUID from list_organizations. Defaults to the user's personal workspace.

operations.description: Edit operations, as accepted by validate_operations: add_node, update_node, delete_node, add_edge, delete_edge, set_agent_prompt, rename_blueprint.

tools.name: list_prompts
tools.title: List prompts
tools.description: List prompts in the iBlueprint prompt library, newest first, with id, title, description, tags, and a link (url). By default lists the user's own prompts; set mine to false to include public prompts. Use get_prompt for a prompt's text.

search.description: Optional text filter on title and description.

mine.description: Only the user's own prompts. Default true.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.title: Get prompt
tools.description: Get a prompt's full text from the iBlueprint prompt library, with its title, description, tags, and a link (url). Placeholders in the text look like {{variable}}.

tools.name: create_prompt
tools.title: Create prompt
tools.description: Save a new private prompt to the user's iBlueprint prompt library. Use {{variable}} for placeholders. Returns its id and a link (url). Only save when the user asked you to.

organizationId.description: Optional organization UUID from list_organizations, to share the prompt with that organization. Omit to keep it personal.

tools.name: update_prompt
tools.title: Update prompt
tools.description: Save a new version of an existing prompt the user can edit: its text, title, description, or tags. The previous version stays in the prompt's history in iBlueprint. Show the user the change and save only once they agree.

content.description: New prompt text. Omit to keep the current text.

title.description: New title. Omit to keep it.

description.description: New description. Omit to keep it.

tags.description: New tags, replacing the current ones. Omit to keep them.

tools.name: list_knowledge_base_documents
tools.title: List knowledge base documents
tools.description: List the documents in a knowledge base, grouped by document set (folder), with each document's id, name, type, size, and processing status. Use get_knowledge_base_document to read one, or search_knowledge_base to find passages.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on document names.

tools.name: get_knowledge_base_document
tools.title: Read knowledge base document
tools.description: Read a knowledge base document's extracted text, 12,000 characters at a time. When more remains, the result has nextOffset; call again with that offset to continue.

documentId.description: Document UUID, from list_knowledge_base_documents or search_knowledge_base.

offset.description: Character offset to start from. Default 0.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.title: Search knowledge base
tools.description: Find the passages in a knowledge base most relevant to a query, using the same search as iBlueprint chatbots and agents. Returns each passage with its document id and name and a relevance score (0-100). Read a whole document with get_knowledge_base_document.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the iBlueprint projects the user belongs to, with id, name, description, their role, and a link (url).

search.description: Optional text filter on the project name.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Create a new iBlueprint project, where goals and tasks are planned. The user becomes its owner. Returns its id and a link (url).

organizationId.description: Organization UUID from list_organizations. Defaults to the user's current organization.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.title: List project goals
tools.description: List a project's goals with id, title, status, dates, and progress (share of tasks done).

tools.name: create_goal
tools.title: Create project goal
tools.description: Add a goal to a project: what the project should achieve, with optional dates. New goals start as drafts. Add the work toward it with create_task, passing the goal's id.

title.description: Short goal title, up to 500 characters.

description.description: What the goal is and how success is measured.

startDate.description: Optional start date, as an ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

endDate.description: Optional target date, as an ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.title: Update project goal
tools.description: Change a goal's title, description, dates, or status (draft, active, completed, cancelled). Only the fields given change.

startDate.description: New start date, as an ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

endDate.description: New target date, as an ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List project tasks
tools.description: List a project's tasks with id, title, status, priority, goal, assignee, and due date. Filter by goal, status, or text.

goalId.description: Optional goal UUID to list only that goal's tasks.

search.description: Optional text filter on the title.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get project task
tools.description: Get one task in full: description, status, priority, goal, assignee, dates, dependencies, and agent instructions.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create project task
tools.description: Add a task to a project, optionally under a goal or a parent task. To assign it to an agent, pass assigneeType "agent", the agent's id from list_agents, and agentPrompt with its instructions. Returns the task's id.

goalId.description: Optional goal UUID this task works toward.

parentTaskId.description: Optional parent task UUID, to make this a subtask.

assigneeId.description: User or agent UUID, with assigneeType.

dueDate.description: Optional due date, as an ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update project task
tools.description: Change a task: status (todo, in_progress, review, blocked, done), priority, title, description, assignee, agent instructions, or due date. Only the fields given change. Mark work finished by setting status to done. As in the app, moving a task assigned to an agent or linked to a blueprint to in_progress starts that work; the result then has executionQueued.

assigneeId.description: User or agent UUID, with assigneeType.

agentPrompt.description: New instructions for an assigned agent.

dueDate.description: New due date, as an ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: add_task_note
tools.title: Add task note
tools.description: Add a note to a task's activity, such as a progress update, a decision, or a question for the team.

tools.name: chat_with_agent
tools.title: Chat with agent
tools.description: Send a message to an iBlueprint agent and get its reply. Without conversationId this starts a new conversation with agentId (from list_agents); pass the returned conversationId to continue it. The agent answers using its own instructions, knowledge, and tools, and may take actions those tools allow, such as sending email. Replies that take longer than 25 seconds come back as status "running": wait, then read the reply with get_agent_conversation.

agentId.description: Agent UUID from list_agents. Required to start a conversation.

conversationId.description: Continue this conversation instead of starting a new one.

message.description: Your message to the agent, up to 10,000 characters.

taskId.description: Optional project task assigned to this agent, to link a new conversation to it.

tools.name: get_agent_conversation
tools.title: Read agent conversation
tools.description: Read the latest messages of a conversation with an agent, and whether the agent is still working on a reply (lastRunStatus "running") or its last turn failed (lastError).

conversationId.description: Conversation UUID, from chat_with_agent or list_agent_conversations.

tools.name: list_agent_conversations
tools.title: List agent conversations
tools.description: List conversations with an agent, newest first, with id, title, last run status, and linked task. Continue one with chat_with_agent and its conversationId.
